responsibilities.description: Applies a business pricing rule: orders with more than 3 lines receive a 10% discount on the subtotal, and the payable amount is subtotal minus discount. This is a domain rule embedded in a notification service.
responsibilities.name: Compute bulk-order discount and payable amount

responsibilities.description: Orchestrates notifying the customer that their order is confirmed, composing the message with order id and payable amount and dispatching it through the injected Mailer port.
responsibilities.name: Send order confirmation to customer
